summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting across login  **No changes made — this is a plan for founder review, per high-impact ticket policy.**  ### What I found by reading the code (no execution/testing done)  The watchlist read/write path is mostly wired correctly: - `WatchlistPage.tsx` has no localStorage/anonymous fallback — every load/save goes through `api.get/post/delete`, and `api.ts` sends `credentials: "include"` on every call, so the session cookie is attached correctly. - `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` correctly scopes `GET /`, `POST /`, `GET /:id`, item add/remo
